title: Professional Services
meta: Operational excellence for Canadian professional services firms: lift utilization and realization, tighten delivery and build continuous improvement.
h1: Grow profitably without burning out your best people
lead: We help professional services firms find the hours, margin and capacity hiding in their delivery processes. Your team defines the measures, owns the changes and keeps improving after we leave.
intro: Where does the time in your firm actually go?

In a professional services firm, your people and their hours are the product. Yet much of that time disappears into rework, unclear handoffs, chasing approvals and work that never reaches an invoice. We work alongside your partners, managers and frontline staff to map how engagements really flow, from proposal to final billing. Together we build process measures that connect daily work to your value proposition, so everyone from the front line to the executive team can see what good looks like. The result is better delivery, higher productivity, more engaged staff and clients who notice the difference.
signs: Utilization looks healthy, but realization and margins keep slipping
Write-offs and write-downs are routine at month end
Senior people spend their days on admin and rework
Each team delivers the same service a different way
Staff are stretched, yet you hesitate to take on new work
challenges: Leakage between hours worked and hours billed
Scope creep, unbilled time and late time entry quietly erode realization. Most firms cannot see where the gap opens up.
Without standard work for core services, quality and turnaround depend on who is assigned, which makes estimating and pricing hard.
Capacity that is hard to see
Partners and managers rarely know true available capacity, so they either overload key people or turn away work.
Busy, unclear workdays wear people down. Losing an experienced professional costs clients, knowledge and recruiting time.
services: We define the measures that matter, including service levels, productivity, speed and quality, so you can set a baseline and track the success of each change.
Review of current practices and tools
We map key processes, analyze financial and operating data, observe work directly and document the management tools you use today.
Through direct observation we separate client value-added work from waiting, rework and admin, revealing the capacity you already have.
We assess how ready your firm is for change, then build a practical plan so partners and staff support the new way of working.
Management tools that link strategy to daily work
We work with leadership to implement tools such as visual boards and regular performance reviews that turn the strategic plan into activities everyone understands.
Where it fits, we streamline intake, scheduling, time capture and reporting with automation and practical AI tools your team will actually use.

steps.text: The client asks for help and shares the brief.

steps.text: The client receives the finished work.

steps.label: Invoice and collect

config.fix_title: Fixed: clear criteria and delegated sign-off
config.fix_text: Review criteria are agreed at kickoff, short check-ins catch issues early, and routine work is signed off by a delegated reviewer. Deliverables keep moving instead of waiting on one partner, and invoices go out when the work is done.

examples: Month-end billing at a 40-person accounting firm
invoices went out two to three weeks after month end while managers chased missing time entries.
daily time capture and a simple billing checklist let invoices go out within days of month end.
Deliverable review in an engineering consultancy
reports waited in a single principal's inbox, stretching turnaround and frustrating clients.
tiered review criteria and delegated sign-off for routine reports shortened turnaround and freed senior time.
Client intake at a mid-sized law practice
new matters were opened by email, with conflicts checks and engagement letters handled inconsistently.
a standard intake workflow with automated reminders made matter opening consistent and easier to track.

More visible capacity, so you can take on work with confidence
Consistent delivery standards across teams and offices
Staff who own their processes and keep improving them
Leadership tools that connect the strategic plan to daily work

faq: How do you measure productivity in a firm that sells expertise?

We start with measures your partners already recognize, such as utilization, realization, turnaround time and rework, then add a small set of service-level and quality measures for key processes. Everything is tracked against your own baseline.

We plan observations and workshops around your delivery calendar and keep time away from client work to a minimum. Much of our analysis uses data you already have, such as time entries and billing reports.
Is this only for large firms?
No. We focus on small and mid-sized Canadian firms, where a few hours recovered per person each week makes a real difference to margin and workload.
Only when it solves a problem we have confirmed. We usually fix the process first, then look at automation or AI tools for intake, scheduling, time capture or reporting.
